---
title: "causal-learn tutorial series"
description: "A hands-on tutorial series for causal discovery with PC, FCI, CD-NOD, GES, LiNGAM, functional causal models, permutation methods, stability checks, and reporting."
categories: [causal-learn, Causal Discovery, Python, Graphs]
---

causal-learn is the tutorial track for causal discovery: learning candidate graph structures while staying honest about assumptions, equivalence classes, hidden confounding, and stability.

</figure>

## Tutorial Sequence

<div class="notebook-guide">
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/00_environment_and_library_tour.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/00_environment_and_library_tour.html">00: Environment And Library Tour</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Sets up causal-learn, introduces the discovery workflow, and uses a small teaching DAG to connect graph structure with data and evaluation metrics.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/01_graphs_dags_cpdag_pag_and_evaluation.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/01_graphs_dags_cpdag_pag_and_evaluation.html">01: Graphs, DAGs, CPDAGs, PAGs, And Evaluation</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Builds graph literacy for discovery work, including DAGs, equivalence classes, PAG edge marks, and metrics for missing, extra, or reversed edges.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/02_synthetic_data_for_causal_discovery.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/02_synthetic_data_for_causal_discovery.html">02: Synthetic Data For Causal Discovery</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Creates controlled simulation settings so discovery algorithms can be studied under known truth, hidden confounding, nonstationarity, and noisy mechanisms.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/03_independence_tests.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/03_independence_tests.html">03: Independence Tests</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Explains the conditional-independence tests that drive constraint-based discovery, including Fisher-Z, discrete tests, conditioning sets, and sample-size sensitivity.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/04_pc_algorithm_continuous_data.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/04_pc_algorithm_continuous_data.html">04: PC Algorithm For Continuous Data</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Applies the PC algorithm to continuous data, showing how alpha choices, sample size, nonlinearity, and evaluation metrics affect the learned graph.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/05_pc_with_prior_knowledge_missing_and_discrete_data.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/05_pc_with_prior_knowledge_missing_and_discrete_data.html">05: PC With Prior Knowledge, Missing Data, And Discrete Data</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Shows how background knowledge, missingness strategies, and discrete variables change PC results and how constraints can help or mislead discovery.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/06_fci_for_latent_confounders.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/06_fci_for_latent_confounders.html">06: FCI For Latent Confounders</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Introduces FCI for settings with hidden common causes, comparing observed-variable PC results with PAG-style output that represents latent ambiguity.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/07_cdnod_for_nonstationary_data.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/07_cdnod_for_nonstationary_data.html">07: CD-NOD For Nonstationary Data</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Uses changing environments and distribution shifts to study CD-NOD, mechanism changes, pooled versus environment-aware discovery, and stability across regimes.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/08_score_based_discovery_ges.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/08_score_based_discovery_ges.html">08: Score-Based Discovery With GES</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Introduces score-based search with GES, BIC-style penalties, mechanism misspecification, and comparisons against constraint-based graph recovery.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/09_exact_search_and_score_functions.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/09_exact_search_and_score_functions.html">09: Exact Search And Score Functions</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Explores exact-search ideas and score functions, emphasizing why exhaustive graph search is informative for small problems but difficult to scale.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/10_lingam_linear_nongaussian_models.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/10_lingam_linear_nongaussian_models.html">10: LiNGAM And Linear Non-Gaussian Models</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Studies LiNGAM assumptions, non-Gaussian noise, coefficient recovery, residual independence, bootstrap edge stability, and threshold sensitivity.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/11_functional_causal_models_anm_pnl.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/11_functional_causal_models_anm_pnl.html">11: Functional Causal Models: ANM And PNL</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Introduces nonlinear functional causal model ideas through additive-noise and post-nonlinear reasoning, with pairwise direction tests and residual diagnostics.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/12_permutation_based_methods_grasp_boss.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/12_permutation_based_methods_grasp_boss.html">12: Permutation-Based Methods: GRaSP And BOSS</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Covers permutation-based search methods, including GRaSP and BOSS, while tracking runtime, depth choices, sample size, and seed stability.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/13_time_series_causal_discovery.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/13_time_series_causal_discovery.html">13: Time-Series Causal Discovery</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Moves discovery into temporal data, using lagged relationships, Granger-style structure, autocorrelation, threshold sensitivity, and temporal graph interpretation.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/14_hidden_representation_learning_gin.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/14_hidden_representation_learning_gin.html">14: Hidden Representation Learning With GIN</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Studies latent measurement structure and hidden representations, showing how indicator variables, cross-loadings, and noise affect graph recovery.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/15_benchmarking_stability_and_sensitivity.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/15_benchmarking_stability_and_sensitivity.html">15: Benchmarking, Stability, And Sensitivity</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Benchmarks multiple discovery methods under assumption stress, tuning changes, sample-size variation, and stability checks so graph claims are not overconfident.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/16_end_to_end_causal_discovery_case_study.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/16_end_to_end_causal_discovery_case_study.html">16: End-To-End Causal Discovery Case Study</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Assembles an applied discovery workflow: exploratory checks, candidate algorithms, constraints, edge stability, final graph selection, and cautious interpretation.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/17_common_pitfalls_reporting_and_limitations.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/causal_learn/17_common_pitfalls_reporting_and_limitations.html">17: Common Pitfalls, Reporting, And Limitations</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Closes with recurring failure modes such as equivalence, hidden confounding, selection bias, weak signals, temporal leakage, duplicate measurements, and reporting limitations.</p>
</article>
</div>
